issue.title: Accept slash as <namepath>
issue.body:
spawn from eslint/eslint#1598.

Doctrine rejects the following comments.

``` js
/**
 * Base component implementation.
 *
 * @constructor
 * @extends module:stb/emitter~Emitter
 */
```

This is because doctrine doesn't support
- `/` as namepath
-  `@extends <namepath>` syntax

issue.body:
Examples:
- fails

```
/**
 * Module desc
 *
 * @module module-name
 */

/**
 * Constructor desc
 *
 * @constructor
 * @alias module:module-name
 */
```
- works

```
/**
 * Module desc
 *
 * @module module
 */

/**
 * Constructor desc
 *
 * @constructor
 * @alias module:module
 */
```
- works

```
/**
 * Module desc
 *
 * @module module_name
 */

/**
 * Constructor desc
 *
 * @constructor
 * @alias module:module_name
 */
```

    "valid-jsdoc": [2, {
